steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation flow described by the case.
Set the single-stage event type to RFQ.
Apply the first available RFQ template so the pricing sheet can be configured.
Add the requested product search result and quantity; exact variant and delivery location selection are not expressible by the catalog.
Complete the pricing sheet fields required for publication.
Assert that the RFQ template was applied.
Assert that the expected pricing-sheet columns rendered.
Invite one QA vendor without inventing the unnamed Vendor A identity.
Set the requested 15-minute event duration; the separate evaluation duration cannot be supplied through this step.
Assert that publication reached a real project page.
Have the invited QA vendor submit a quote so the event can be closed and its post-bidding controls exercised.
Assert that the vendor bid was accepted.
End the bidding window to reach the post-bidding state.
Use the available evaluation-time action as the closest observable check that a 30-minute evaluation period can be saved after bidding.
Open the rejected-bids surface available from the event's stage menu.
Assert that the Rejected Bids view opened.
